items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Felicia Sanders wrote... Do you remember her?

ctx.x: ...and Maxwell. Three saxophones and a rhythm section. It was just a sextet. But it was some hard swing, and that was enjoyment for me. Another thing, "You're Part Of Me"; that's a tune of mine I wrote, and Felicia Sanders wrote... Do you remember her?
